MP4DX - Last 5 Turns Coin Steal: During the Last 5 Turns, a player who ends their move on a space where another player stands steals 10 coins from that player (all of their coins if they have fewer than 10). Works for every player, human or CPU. It's skipped for your partner in Team Battle, and when a Mega Mushroom or the Bowser Suit already crushed that player on the same space. The board host announces the new rule at the end of the Last Five Turns Event.
Requires the 'bonus stars' ISO (new text in mess/board_e.dat, bank 57); on other ISOs the code does nothing. Only for MP4 DX (GMPE01).
